messages.subject: Project Beacon - engagement
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter on a proposed acquisition (Project Beacon). The target is a chilled-food manufacturer in Yorkshire; founder-owned. We've signed an NDA in principle and expect to move quickly - heads of terms in the next few weeks, signing ideally early October.

Can you and the team take this on? Daniel will be day-to-day from our side.

Best,
Daniel
